page.notes: Greek word after "tuum)" is uncertain (marked [?]); the printed letters are faint and I read it as a rough approximation of τὸν γεννησμὸν σου. Page is slightly stained at the bottom; no text lost. Long s is transcribed as plain s throughout (e.g. "triftitia" = tristitia, "Iefa" = Iesa). "Gravior" and "Grauior" in the print are spelled as in the original, "Grauior".
